description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You make a Strike using a weaponized Black Market cyber-augment.

You redline the augment the way you'd redline a scrap gun, and it answers the same way — bigger, once, and it costs you after. Treat the augment as one grade higher for that single Strike. Whether the Strike hits or not, you permanently gain +1 Drift when you do this — the augment doesn't forget being pushed, even if you never do it again.
